name: repo-harness-tuner
description: Ask naturally what Codex should do next, then tune repo harnesses and recommend minimal adapter skills with approval gates.

interface.shortDescription: Ask “다음에 뭐해?” or “기획해줘” and get the next safe Codex step.
interface.longDescription: Repo Harness Tuner is a Codex workspace tuner for natural-language project direction. In a repo context, prompts like “다음에 뭐해?”, “기획해줘”, “구조 잡아줘”, “알아서 해줘”, or “What should Codex do next?” should start with a read-only next pass: inspect the repo, label the work type, propose one safe next action, show approval boundaries, and suggest validation. It helps Codex keep planning, development support, review, harness tuning, history, and minimal skill recommendations organized as a project evolves. It writes files, changes repo policy, installs adapter skills, or touches release/deploy/dependency-sensitive areas only after explicit approval. It includes codex-harness-setup for repo-local AGENTS.md and Docs/AI/* harness setup, release-check for fresh-copy validation, fixture tests for regression coverage, and recommendation-only ECC seed catalog support without bulk installing external hooks, MCP servers, slash commands, native agents, marketplace entries, or policy changes.
capabilities: Codex team and skill factory planning
Repo-local agent and skill artifact generation
Continuous skill curator from history and eval evidence
Closed-loop diagnosis from eval and history
defaultPrompt: 알아서 다음 작업 잡아줘. 파일 쓰기나 설치는 승인 받고 해.
이 repo에서 Codex가 다음에 할 일 알려줘
검수 기준과 다음 검증 방법 잡아줘
Handle the next step, but ask before writing files or installing anything
Tell me what Codex should do next
Recommend minimal skills and agents for this repo
